property_summary: For every caller address a and target owner newOwner, only the original deployer (admin) can successfully call setOwner(newOwner) — i.e., after any call to setOwner(newOwner) by any caller, c.owner() equals newOwner if and only if the caller was the admin; the mutant that checks msg.sender==owner instead of admin allows a non-admin (specifically the current owner when owner!=admin) to succeed and change owner for some inputs.
change_summary: Change onlyAdmin modifier to compare against owner instead of admin, allowing different callers to pass and potentially change who can call setOwner, affecting owner after call.
